notes.title: Refined Paths | Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
[p][b]Chapter Two is finally here with the [i]Refined Paths[/i] update![/b][/p][p]The developer has been hard at work, incorporating feedback from playtesters on the beta branch. This update brings tons of new features, bug fixes, and quality-of-life improvements throughout the game. It is also 40% off until August 15th. [/p][p][i]Let’s dive into what’s [b]new[/b]![/i]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517419/52120d98806fec713aaf27a8e03b5862818a6021.gif"][/img][/p][p] [b]v1.0.5 Patch Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New Missions & Achievements[/b] – Take on fresh challenges and unlock brand-new achievements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player Health Mechanic[/b] – Manage your vitality with the newly introduced health system.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual Upgrades[/b] – Added enhanced visual effects to boxes and various models for a richer atmosphere.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Research Area[/b] – Explore an all-new zone filled with hidden secrets to discover.[/p][/*][*][p][b]More Items & Devices[/b] – Expanded the arsenal with additional gear to find and use.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Revamped Menu UI[/b] – Updated the interface for smoother navigation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Drops[/b] – When you play, you’ll receive a drop after a certain amount of time. These drops include added lore for you to enjoy, and you can also sell them on the Steam Market to earn extra Steam credit — all while helping support our development ːsteamhappyː.[/p][/*][*][p][b]And Much More…[/b] – Plenty of smaller tweaks, fixes, and surprises await!

[i]Please note that the Patch Notes may be updated in the future to include additional changes.[/i][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: V1.0.4
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]

- The generator and server speed have been increased.
- Tweaked Harry's model with visual and functional changes.
- Refined the parkour section for better flow and challenge.
- Increased the visibility range on the flashlight.
- Minor UI changes.

[i]Please note that changelogs may be updated in the future to include additional changes.[/i]

notes.title: V1.0.3
notes.content:
Steam has fixed the issue, and we can now release V1.0.3!
Here's everything that's included:

- Added glowing eyes to Harry.
- Set fog options as default to fix flashlight issue.
- Made changes to the box and visual effects.
- Added a click sound effect to the menu.
- Changed the hard drive pickup sound effect.


[i]Please note that changelogs may be updated in the future to include additional changes.[/i]

notes.title: V1.0.2
notes.content:
- The monster, which has been named Harry by the community, will now punish players that get cornered.
- Increased Harry's attack speed.
- Made the portal faster.
- Something now watches you.


[i]Please note that changelogs may be updated in the future to include additional changes.[/i]
